esp32_hub_target.ble_mtu_note: Default BLE ATT MTU is 20 bytes per notify packet; app MUST buffer incoming chunks until '\n' before parsing JSON!

commands_phone_to_esp2.effect: Silences ESP32 #1 speaker for 30s and logs alert_dismissed on Server
Raises CRITICAL SOS_PRESSED incident on Server (0 driver Safety Score penalty!)
Requests immediate STATUS:{...} JSON snapshot from ESP32 #2

notifications_esp2_to_phone.meaning: Real-time safety alert forwarded from Pi 4 -> ESP2 -> Phone
Live UART2 hardware GPS pushed every 2s while BLE connected
Full ESP2 hub status JSON on STATUS command
Command accepted by ESP2 and forwarded over USB UART to Pi 4

optional_server_http_endpoints.pair_otp_issue_operator: POST /api/v1/phone/pair_otp (alias /api/v1/phone/pair/otp also supported; requires operator token; returns 5-min single-use pair_code)
optional_server_http_endpoints.pair_phone_redeem: POST /api/v1/phone/pair (no prior login needed on /driver; rate-limited; body: {vehicle_id, pair_code, driver_id}; returns driver_phone_token)
optional_server_http_endpoints.phone_telemetry_fallback: POST /api/v1/phone/telemetry (Bearer driver_phone_token; sends phone_gps fallback when hardware GPS indoors)

web_bluetooth_constraints: Chrome/Edge Android requires HTTPS (use Cloudflare Tunnel or localhost) — plain http://192.168.x.x is blocked by browser security policy.
Safari on iOS does NOT implement Web Bluetooth; iPhone users must use Bluefy browser or a native/Flutter app.
Do NOT remove newline '\n' terminator when writing to NUS RX characteristic.
